design_context: Module top with clk, clk_div2. clk is primary 10ns, clk_div2 is generated by dividing clk by 2 at pin div_reg/Q.
objective: Generate SDC with primary clock and correctly constrained generated clock.
constraints: create_clock -name clk -period 10 [get_ports clk]; create_generated_clock -name clk_div2 -source [get_ports clk] -divide_by 2 [get_pins div_reg/Q]
